title: Future BG reading is continously broadcast if option 'send display glucose' is enabled
symptom: After changing the phone clock forward and back, xDrip continuously broadcasts a future BG reading when 'Send display glucose' is enabled. The UI also displays that future reading continuously.
cause: When processing a new BgReading with 'Send display glucose' enabled, the youngest BgReading record is retrieved from the DB and sent instead, which can be a future record.
fix: Delete future records via System status.
evidence_quote: The fix was to delete future records via _System status_.
